scope: Cmd+S and CAD file save, zoom-independent label heights, optional camera details, persistence, native save cancellation, original-file protection, DWG/DXF round trips, and existing overlay editing. Tests use public/demo drawings; private user drawings are not included.

checks: Changing the viewport zoom does not change the CAD label height
DXF label heights match model dimensions and omit optional camera metadata by default
DXF keeps exact RGB colors on cameras, sectors, cables and flags
DXF export contains the base, editable cable vertices, length flags, camera and Polish labels
Exported DXF reopens as ordinary CAD geometry without its local overlay
CAD text height persists when the source drawing is reopened
DWG retains exact RGB colors after conversion and independent WASM parsing
A real AutoCAD 2018 DWG reopens through the independent LibreDWG WASM reader
The Cmd+S menu action writes camera and cable geometry into a DWG that opens without the local project
Overlay-only export keeps the original drawing coordinates and excludes the base geometry
File save finishes and embeds a pending cable route together with the base
Explicit text height and optional camera parameters are embedded in CAD
Saving a file resets the full-drawing option after an installation-only export
Cancelling the native save dialog leaves the project open and unchanged
Choosing the source file as the export destination is rejected without modifying it
No renderer errors during the complete export workflow
Create a named drawing overlay layer
Middle-button panning during cable drawing stops on release and preserves the draft
Cable clicks create one route and a live total-length flag
Dragging a route vertex updates its length from 10 m to 8 m
Undo and redo restore the full route
Add an extra route-linked length flag
Move a length flag independently from its cable geometry
Draw a custom camera symbol, save its model and FOV, and place an instance
Edit camera rotation, range and size with a visible field of view
Move a camera together with its field of view
Add an installation point and editable text
Duplicate, delete and undo a drawn object
Save a reusable cable type in the local library
Overlay layers can be hidden and locked without editing the base drawing
Overlay geometry and metadata are persisted on disk
Another drawing has independent working layers
Restart restores the drawing overlays and reusable library without manual merging
Closing with an unfinished route completes and persists it before quitting
